title: Quality Dense Slovakian Yautia Bake
description: A malty, dense, crowd-pleaser Slovakian dish featuring yautia, this paleo-friendly bake is perfect for any occasion. It combines the natural sweetness of yautia with the richness of nuts and seeds.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced yautia, almond flour, coconut sugar, chopped walnuts, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and malt syrup until well combined.
Add the egg mixture to the yautia mixture and stir until everything is fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the edges are set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
